facts.name: Sharon I. Hamilton
facts.assignment: Profile: all county cases in Plantation Key; acting circuit dependency, family, domestic violence, probate and duty-judge assignment.

contact.contact_note: Published office phone; no separately identified assistant-only phone or personal judge email.

scheduling.summary: File motion first; request hearing from JA with case/style, motion and time. Coordinate offered dates without copying JA on counsel-only discussions; await JA confirmation, then file/serve notice. Later section H also directs phone scheduling.

communications.summary: JA communications carry case number/name/matter and copy parties. Section A directs email and separately says all communications by telephone; exceptions for persons excused from email are also stated. No text messages. Preserve differing channels.

proposed_orders.summary: Use Portal proposed-order section with cover letter certifying agreement or stating disagreement. Profile links circuit protocol; shared memo already collected, current protocol applicability remains shared review.

courtesy_copies.summary: Section E: Word or link by email to clerk/JA, five days before hearing/trial; mail/hand delivery for excused self-represented litigants. Earlier all-materials deadline is three business days. Exhibit-specific delivery language also differs; consult original.

remote_appearance.summary: Advance permission by motion; request ten days ahead and join fifteen minutes early. Approved order supplies Zoom credentials. Section H distinguishes non-evidentiary hearings up to thirty minutes from longer/evidentiary hearings; do not infer blanket permission.

conferral.summary: Clear hearing dates with opposing counsel; state other parties’ consent when seeking remote appearance. No separate general prefiling conferral requirement identified in bounded profile review.

noncivil_basic_operations.summary: Shared scheduling/submission/appearance instructions retained. Criminal Zoom guide linked but not substantively reviewed.

conflicts.summary: Section A directs all communications by email and separately all communications by telephone; hearing scheduling paragraph uses email, section H phone. Channels retained without choosing authority.
